text:
I sorted the companies by pending contacts. Acme Industrial was at the top with 112 pending, and I accepted all 112. Acme now shows 0 pending and 177 accepted.

Early on I opened Acme before I had read the sorted list. I then went back and confirmed it was first before selecting or accepting anything.

The 112 accepted contacts still show as selected. You may want to clear the selection before your next bulk action.
